title: No more midnight rush: How Singles’ Day is being rebuilt for China’s cautious consumers
paragraphs: No more midnight rush: How Singles’ Day is being rebuilt for China’s cautious consumers

Eighteen editions on, China’s biggest annual shopping festival is growing up. As the sales frenzy gives way to longer promotions and more cautious spending, brands and platforms are rethinking how to win over shoppers.
SHANGHAI: Three models in wool coats stand before a wall of glass bricks as a cinema camera rolls past.
